Per chunk sub-items: not-X-not-Y-Z: 0 (line 40 "Not a disaster." is one Not, no second); anaphora triples: 0; self-grading superlatives: 0 (grep most useful|best|powerful in body: 0); number+retraction: 0; abstraction-noun stacks: 0; verb triplets with an empty leg: line 40 "shipped, worked, and quietly went unused" each leg concrete, stays inside.

"Beat" is named in the rule as maintainer dialect (trainer beat sheet, check_workshop "room-scale beats"); a product owner or designer reading the projected slide has no referent for "room beats". rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.

Not covered by the task-sizing, LO or menu exceptions. Harm (emphasis loses meaning, nothing stands out) is mild. Sibling AE101 prework bolds short handles only.
